# Vectors: platform-broker-json

Guideline baseline: `2e32a6b` · Kind: broker-json · 18 vectors · [All vector files](README.md)

Content of the file broker.json of the Message Bus storage (RIG 4.1.1, REQ-CNT-003): the mandatory elements Address (IP address or host name), SecurePort (UINT16, 1 … 65535) and MaxPacketSize (INT32, 262144 … 268435455). RIG 4.1.1 has no example of the file; all vectors are constructed. The syntax of Address, further elements and SecurePort 0 follow SF-100 (RIG 4.1.1 since guideline 168e1d1).

## V-BRK-001

**Minimal broker.json with host name and the smallest MaxPacketSize**

- Expected: valid
- Illustrates: [REQ-CNT-003](../../requirements/view/cnt.md#req-cnt-003)
- Origin: constructed RIG 4.1.1
- Status: reviewed

Notes: The three mandatory elements of RIG 4.1.1; Address as a single-label host name (e.g. the container name of the broker), MaxPacketSize at its minimum 262144 (256 KiB).

Content of `broker.json`:

```json
{
  "Address": "mqtt-broker",
  "SecurePort": 8883,
  "MaxPacketSize": 262144
}
```
